description: This Java class 'DaoUtil' provides utility methods for data conversion, pagination, batch processing, and entity subtype creation within the Thingsboard project. It includes methods for transforming page data, converting UUIDs, and handling entity types and info.

classes.name: DaoUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for data transformation, pagination, batch processing, and entity subtype creation in the Thingsboard project.

methods.name: toPageData
methods.description: Converts a Page of ToData objects to PageData with data list.

methods.name: pageToPageData
methods.description: Converts a Slice to PageData, handling Page and non-Page slices.

methods.name: toPageable
methods.description: Creates Pageable object from PageLink with various overloads for sorting.

methods.name: convertDataList
methods.description: Converts a collection of ToData objects to a list of data objects.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Retrieves data object from ToData or Optional<ToData>.

methods.name: toUUIDs
methods.description: Converts list of UUIDBased objects to list of UUIDs.

methods.name: fromUUIDs
methods.description: Maps list of UUIDs to list of entities using provided function.

methods.name: toEntityId
methods.description: Creates entity ID from UUID using provided creator function.

methods.name: processInBatches
methods.description: Processes data in batches using a finder function and a processor consumer.

methods.name: processBatches
methods.description: Processes data in batches with a custom batch processor.

methods.name: getStringId
methods.description: Returns string representation of UUIDBased ID.

methods.name: convertTenantEntityTypesToDto
methods.description: Converts list of entity type strings to EntitySubtype DTOs for a tenant.

methods.name: convertTenantEntityInfosToDto
methods.description: Deprecated method converting EntityInfo list to EntitySubtype DTOs, sorted by type.
